subject: Removes empty history arrays in json (#317)
reason: The change only deletes "history": [] keys from six command JSON definition files. The code generator (utils/generate-command-code.py) treats an empty history array and an absent history key identically — `if not self.desc.get("history")` is true for both — and emits `#define <CMD>_History NULL` either way, so the generated commands.def and the compiled command table (and hence COMMAND DOCS/INFO replies) are unchanged. It is a pure source-cleanup with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
